item.description:
隨機試驗：進一步議題

原文章節： Randomized Trials: Some Further Issues

📚 學習目標

  • To deine key concepts of epidemiologic study design in the context of randomized trials: sample size, type I error, type II error, power, generalizability (external validity), and internal validity.
  • To calculate and interpret eficacy in a randomized trial.
  • To describe the design and results of ive important randomized trials.
  • To deine the four major phases of randomized trials that are used by the Federal Drug Administration for evaluating new drugs in the United States.
  • To introduce several ethical considerations as they relate to randomized trials.
